jobs.desc: About Trusted Shops Trusted Shops creates digital trust between people, businesses, and AI Agents. Every day, millions of consumers rely on our solutions to make confident online decisions, while businesses use our products to build trust, strengthen customer relationships, and grow sustainably. With around 700 colleagues across Europe, more than 25,000 online shops, and over 40 million consumers in our Community of Trust, we are helping shape a safer and more transparent digital world. But trust is not only at the heart of our products – it also shapes how we work together. We believe in collaboration, ownership, and the freedom to do your best work through a flexible hybrid work culture. Join us and help create a digital world where trust, transparency, and meaningful connections drive every interaction. To strengthen our Engineering Team, we are looking for a Fullstack Engineer- AWS, TypeScript, Java, Spring Boot, React, Next.js (m/f/d) (Hybrid in Cologne or remote in Berlin / Full-time / Permanent contract) A s a Fullstack Engineer in our Consumer Domain, you will help shape the experience of millions of consumers using Trusted Shops products. Working within the Consumer Membership Team, you will focus on expanding existing backend services and building new ones within our AWS landscape while contributing to frontend applications where needed. You will be part of a cross-functional product team that includes Software Engineers, QA, Product Manager, Agile Coach, and Growth experts, all working together to improve the consumer experience through experimentation, fast feedback loops, and data-driven decisions. Following our “You build it, you own it” philosophy, you will take ownership of solutions throughout their full lifecycle, from development to production and continuous improvement. Your Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs within our AWS-based cloud architecture Build modern, high-quality frontend applications using React, Next.js, and TypeScript to create seamless user experiences Take ownership of features throughout the entire software lifecycle - from implementation and deployment to monitoring and production support Improve infrastructure automation, scalability, and reliability using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles. Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to deliver high-quality solutions and drive technical excellence. Foster a collaborative team environment by sharing knowledge, communicating effectively with diverse stakeholders, and resolving challenges constructively. Your Profile Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Media Informatics, or a related field -or equivalent practical experience 3+ years of professional experience as a Fullstack Software Engineer Strong backend development experience with TypeScript, Java, Spring Boot, or comparable technologies Solid frontend development skills with React, Next.js, and TypeScript Hands-on experience building, deploying, and operating cloud-native applications on AWS (e.g., Lambda, ECS, or similar services). Experience with Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools is a strong plus. Proven experience using AI-powered development tools (e.g., Claude or similar) to accelerate software development, testing, debugging, and documentation, while critically evaluating and validating AI-generated outputs. Collaborative, proactive, and curious mindset with a passion for continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and mentoring teammates. Business-fluent English skills. German language skills are a plus Our Tech Stack While your primary focus will be as described in the job ad, you'll work in an environment that includes: Frontend: React, TypeScript Backend: Node.js, Java, Spring Boot, Python Cloud Infrastructure: AWS, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, Terraform Databases: DynamoDB, PostgreSQL Developer Experience: GitHub, CircleCI, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code What We Offer Hybrid work: Flexible remote work combined with team time in the office Workation: Temporarily work from within the EU, Iceland, Liechtenstein, or Norway Permanent contract with Europe’s trusted brand One “Self Education Day” per month 27 vacation days + 3.5 additional days off (Christmas, New Year’s Eve, Carnival) Buddy programme structured onboarding Individual training and development opportunities Regular team, unit and company events Health Pass (free online and offline sports, fitness, and health courses) BUILD A COMMUNITY OF TRUST WITH US - #cometotrust Not sure if you are what we are looking for? jobs.title: Software Release & Configuration Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.desc: As a Software Release Configuration Manager (m/f/d), you will be the central point of control for all software delivery activities across multiple software engineering teams. You will oversee feature development progress, manage release schedules, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality software for our advanced drone systems. You will coordinate daily operations, manage tickets and workflow, and act as the decision-maker when priorities conflict, always keeping delivery commitments on track. This roles requires a mix of technical understanding of software architecture, organizational skills and assertive leadership. In a highly skilled team, you will play a key role in pushing the boundaries of modern software solutions for our high-tech drones. You will work closely with stakeholders from our software teams as well as adjacent departments (such as hardware development and product management). By ensuring timely software deliveries, you will support Quantum-Systems in its mission to become the leader for aerial data collection solutions with unmanned aerial systems (sUAV). What is your Day to Day Mission: Own the release process for all software components, including embedded firmware, ground control software, and AI mission packages. Monitor and track development progress across multiple teams, ensuring alignment with release timelines. Manage configuration and version control for all software artifacts and environments. Lead daily stand-ups and coordination meetings, driving clarity and accountability. Maintain and prioritize the backlog, ensuring tickets are properly managed and resolved. Act as the decision authority when trade-offs are needed to meet delivery deadlines. Define and enforce release policies, including branching strategies, quality gates, and approval workflows. Collaborate with stakeholders (engineering, QA, product management) to ensure smooth and predictable releases. Continuously improve release processes, introducing automation and best practices where possible. What you bring to the team: A successfully completed degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or a comparable qualification. 5+ years of experience in software release management, configuration management, or similar roles. Proven experience in managing projects and leading teams. Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, version control systems (GitLab/GitHub), and branching strategies. Experience with ticketing systems (e.g., Jira) and agile methodologies. Familiarity with embedded software development and multi-component systems. Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to make tough decisions under pressure. Experience with DO-178C is advantageous. Strong written and verbal English communication skills Proactive, organized and a team player mindset Ability to balance multiple assignments Why Quantum-Systems: We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus. We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary. We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data. We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth. Our benefits: Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later. Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance. Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance. Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership. Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy. Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia. Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together. Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored. Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday. About us: Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors. Our commitment: We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success. At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.desc: div class= content-intro p At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you. /p /div p strong So, what’s the role all about? /strong nbsp; /p p The Senior Automation Engineer develops tests and maintains the NiCE CXone software platform. Key responsibilities include all tiers of the NiCE CXone technology, including (but not limited to) Test design and test Strategy for NiCE CXone products and features test automation, code reviews, resolving defects encountered during the QA cycle, supporting the production environment, and assisting other developers in a team environment utilizing agile development processes. nbsp; /p p strong u nbsp; /u /strong /p p strong How will you make an impact? /strong nbsp; /p ul li Serves as the senior QA professional in the R amp;D group /li li Committed to the quality of the released content /li li Reviewing new designs, challenging them to detect potential quality concerns, and proposing ways to address them /li li Take an active role in-process inspection and improvement /li li Actively track the team’s tasks, analyze the testing needs and define QA activities and ownership /li li Plan, define and execute tests as part of the team’s QA related activities /li li Continuously analyze and challenge existing testing coverage (manual and automatic tests) /li li Monitor the test and production environments /li li Write and maintain E2E automated tests /li /ul p nbsp; /p p strong Have you got what it takes? /strong /p ul li At least 4 - 7 years of experience in QA/Automation positions /li li The wide perspective of complex product solutions (business, technical, architecture) /li li Experience in test design and execution for complex systems (manual and automatic). Deep understanding of QA methodologies /li li Comprehensive experience working in an Agile development process /li li Hands-on experience in strong Playwright, Java/JS or other OO language /strong . Experience with writing strong SQL queries /strong /li li Fluent in English /li li Team player /li li Experience with AWS /li li Experience with SDLC of SaaS products /li li Hands-on experience with automated testing tools both for UI and APIs testing /li /ul p nbsp; /p p strong Enjoy NiCE-FLEX! /strong nbsp; /p p At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere. nbsp; /p p strong nbsp; /strong /p p strong Requisition ID: 9630 /strong br strong Reporting into: /strong Director, Engineering. br strong Role Type: /strong Individual Contributor. /p p strong #LI-Hybrid /strong /p div class= content-conclusion p em strong About NiCE /strong /em /p p em NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions. /em /p p em Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries. /em /p p em NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
